status: Experimental reference assumptions; not a site-average measurement or construction design
datum: Model ground-floor FFL 0.000 m; assume adjacent ground at -0.150 m solely for this study
boundsMeaning: Illustrative lower/reference/upper cases, not confidence bounds. Clay/tree effects, made ground, drains, groundwater or adjacent foundations can require deeper/wider foundations or a different system. Ashley Heights has mature trees: their influence is not assessed.

strip.stemMaterial: Foundation-grade masonry envelope; product and below-ground suitability unselected

gardenSlab.basis: Ground-bearing floor only. Perimeter walls and terrace posts bear on separate foundations. Reinforcement, subgrade, fill and insulation arrangement unselected.

basement.basis: Continuous reinforced-concrete raft concept under all six retaining-wall runs; no separate strip footings assumed beneath it. 300 mm is a spatial/budget allowance, not a thickness calculation. Local thickenings, punching, bending, crack control, wall-base fixity, waterstops, waterproofing and temporary works remain undesigned. The 352.5 mm retaining-wall envelope still coordinates the cavity wall above, not a calculated RC thickness. F02 lowers the raft top to -3.000 m beneath the unchanged -2.800 m finished floor, reserving 200 mm for the floor build-up. Retaining-wall and column bases follow the raft; excavation and groundwater heads update.
basement.floorBuildUpBasis: 200 mm dimensional budget above the raft, preserving the authored basement FFL. Waterproofing type, drainage/access, gas protection, insulation strength/thermal performance, screed reinforcement/drying and edge details are unselected. Layers must be redesigned with the waterproofing specialist and structural engineer; no system performance is claimed.

loadBasis: Characteristic/service-load budgets, not extracted reactions: garage reference 45 kN/m rounds a 24.6 kN/m two-storey masonry allowance (6 m x 0.205 m x 20 kN/m3), two floor allowances of 2.5 kN/m2 x 2.5 m tributary width (12.5 kN/m), and roof 1.5 kN/m2 x 2.5 m (3.75 kN/m). Garden 25 kN/m is a wall/terrace budget; 35 kN is an independent illustrative post reaction. Basement total superstructure 1,800 kN is a separate whole-footprint service budget, not a completed load takedown. Do not add the post budget to the line-load budget as if independently verified. G01: the illustrative superstructure budgets and additional permanent-load allowance exclude the separately measured vehicle deck, local RC bands/bearing nodes and cinema bearing masonry. Their actual modelled volumes and assumed densities are added explicitly. This is still not a load takedown; empty-box uplift excludes these later construction stages.
calculationBasis: Gross unfactored pressure screens against assumed gross allowable bearing, NOT Eurocode 7 ULS verification or settlement design. Include footing concrete 24 kN/m3, foundation masonry 20 kN/m3, soil cover on projections 18 kN/m3; raft/retaining concrete 25 kN/m3. Pressure screens omit eccentricity and local load spreading. Uplift uses water 9.81 kN/m3 at the raft underside and compares un-factored dead weight only, without relying on pumps or favourable soil friction.
